knowledge:
- key_parameters: rank=The taxonomic rank to agglomerate or plot by (e.g., "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Family", "Genus") ;; assay.type=The name of the assay containing abundance data (e.g., "counts", "relabundance") ;; features=Specific features (taxa or sample metadata columns) to plot or subset ;; detections=Numeric vector of abundance thresholds to evaluate prevalence ;; prevalences=Numeric vector of prevalence thresholds to evaluate ;; tip.colour.by=Variable from rowData or metadata to map to tree tip colors ;; tip.size.by=Variable from rowData or metadata to map to tree tip sizes ;; edge.colour.by=Variable from rowData or metadata to map to tree edge colors ;; show.label=Logical or character vector specifying which tip/node labels to display ;; time.col=Column in colData representing the time or ordering variable for serial plots ;; type=Goodness of fit measure for DMN plots (e.g., "laplace")
- alternatives: scater=Offers general plotting functions for SummarizedExperiment objects (e.g., plotColData, plotExpression, plotRowData) which can be used alongside miaViz ;; patchwork=Used to combine multiple plots (e.g., abundance and sample metadata) ;; ggtree=Used internally for tree plotting ;; tidygraph/ggraph=Used internally for graph plotting
- when_to_use: Use when performing microbiome or metagenomic data analysis and needing to visualize taxonomic abundance distributions, prevalence landscapes, phylogenetic trees decorated with abundance/prevalence metadata, sample/feature networks, longitudinal trajectories, or DMN clustering diagnostics.
- pitfalls: Plotting large trees rarely makes sense; users should subset trees (e.g., top 100 taxa) before plotting with plotRowTree ;; When plotting abundance without specifying a taxonomic rank, ensure the data is agglomerated to a certain taxonomic rank first to avoid overcomplicating the plot ;; ggtree can only plot node labels in a rectangular layout (e.g., layout="rectangular") ;; plotSeries is not advised for a large number of features; a maximum of 20 features can be plotted at the same time ;; In trajectory plotting with geom_path, sorting data (e.g., by time) is crucial to prevent geom_path from picking up NA values and breaking the visualization

workflows.name: abundance_plotting
workflows.intent: Plot taxonomic abundance by rank, subset by prevalence, and combine with sample metadata.
workflows.stages: 1. Transform assay to relative abundance ;; 2. Plot abundance by taxonomic rank ;; 3. Agglomerate and plot abundance ;; 4. Filter by prevalent taxa and plot ;; 5. Combine abundance plot with sample metadata using patchwork
workflows.code:
GlobalPatterns <- transformAssay(GlobalPatterns, method = "relabundance")
plotAbundance(GlobalPatterns, rank = "Kingdom", assay.type = "relabundance")
GlobalPatterns_king <- agglomerateByRank(GlobalPatterns, "Kingdom")
plotAbundance(GlobalPatterns_king, assay.type = "relabundance")
prev_phylum <- getPrevalent(GlobalPatterns, rank = "Phylum", detection = 0.01)
plotAbundance(
    GlobalPatterns[rowData(GlobalPatterns)$Phylum %in% prev_phylum],
    rank = "Phylum",
    assay.type = "relabundance")
library(patchwork)
plots <- plotAbundance(
    GlobalPatterns[rowData(GlobalPatterns)$Phylum %in% prev_phylum],
    features = "SampleType",
    rank = "Phylum",
    assay.type = "relabundance")
plots$abundance / plots$SampleType + plot_layout(heights = c(9, 1))

workflows.name: prevalence_plotting
workflows.intent: Visualize feature prevalence across different abundance thresholds and relative abundances.
workflows.stages: 1. Plot row prevalence across detection thresholds ;; 2. Plot prevalent abundance against mean relative abundance ;; 3. Plot sample prevalence across multiple detection and prevalence steps
workflows.code:
plotRowPrevalence(
    GlobalPatterns, rank = "Phylum", detections = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.2))
plotPrevalentAbundance(GlobalPatterns, rank = "Family", colour.by = "Phylum") +
    scale_x_log10()
plotPrevalence(
    GlobalPatterns, rank = "Phylum",
    detections = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20)/100,
    prevalences = seq(0.1, 1, 0.1))

workflows.name: tree_plotting
workflows.intent: Visualize phylogenetic trees decorated with taxonomic, abundance, and prevalence metadata.
input: GlobalPatterns (TreeSummarizedExperiment object with a rowTree slot)
workflows.stages: 1. Agglomerate to Genus level ;; 2. Calculate quality control metrics (mean, detection) ;; 3. Filter to top 100 taxa ;; 4. Plot row tree with decorated tips (color, size) ;; 5. Plot tree with specific node/tip labels and rectangular layout ;; 6. Plot tree with colored edges
workflows.code:
library(scater)
library(mia)
altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus") <- agglomerateByRank(GlobalPatterns,"Genus")
altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus") <- addPerFeatureQC(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"))
rowData(altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"))$log_mean <- log(
    rowData(altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"))$mean)
rowData(altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"))$detected <- rowData(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"))$detected / 100
top_taxa <- getTop(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"),
    method="mean",
    top=100L,
    assay.type="counts")
plotRowTree(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus")[top_taxa,], tip.colour.by = "log_mean",
    tip.size.by = "detected")
plotRowTree(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus")[top_taxa,],
    tip.colour.by = "log_mean", tip.size.by = "detected", show.label = TRUE)
labels <- c("Genus:Providencia", "Genus:Morganella", "0.961.60")
plotRowTree(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus")[top_taxa,],
    tip.colour.by = "log_mean",
    tip.size.by = "detected",
    show.label = labels,
    layout="rectangular")
plotRowTree(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus")[top_taxa,],
    edge.colour.by = "Phylum",
    tip.colour.by = "log_mean")

workflows.name: graph_plotting
workflows.intent: Plot sample or feature graphs integrated with metadata from a SummarizedExperiment.
workflows.stages: 1. Load graph data ;; 2. Plot column graph mapping sample metadata to node colors and edge weights ;; 3. Store graph in metadata slot and plot
workflows.code:
data(col_graph)
plotColGraph(
    col_graph,
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"),
    colour.by = "SampleType",
    edge.colour.by = "weight",
    edge.width.by = "weight",
    show.label = TRUE)
metadata(altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"))$graph <- col_graph
plotColGraph(
    altExp(GlobalPatterns,"Genus"),
    name = "graph",
    colour.by = "SampleType",
    edge.colour.by = "weight",
    edge.width.by = "weight",
    show.label = TRUE)

workflows.name: serial_data_and_trajectories
workflows.intent: Visualize longitudinal/serial abundance data and plot subject trajectories on ordination space.
workflows.stages: 1. Transform assay to relative abundance ;; 2. Plot abundance series over time faceted by metadata ;; 3. Run MDS ordination ;; 4. Plot subject trajectories on ordination space ;; 5. Calculate stepwise divergence and plot top divergent trajectories
workflows.code:
library("miaTime")
data(SilvermanAGutData, package="miaTime")
tse <- SilvermanAGutData
tse <- transformAssay(tse, method = "relabundance")
taxa <- getTop(tse, 2)
plotSeries(
    tse,
    assay.type = "relabundance",
    time.col = "DAY_ORDER",
    features = taxa,
    colour.by = "Family",
    facet.by = "Vessel"
    )
plotSeries(
    tse[taxa,],
    time.col = "DAY_ORDER",
    colour.by = "Family",
    linetype.by = "Phylum",
    assay.type = "relabundance")
plotSeries(
    tse,
    time.col = "DAY_ORDER",
    features = getTop(tse, 5),
    colour.by = "Family",
    linetype.by = "Phylum",
    assay.type = "counts")
library(miaTime)
data(hitchip1006, package = "miaTime")
tse <- hitchip1006
tse <- transformAssay(tse, method = "relabundance")
tse <- runMDS(
    tse, FUN = getDissimilarity, method = "bray", name = "PCoA_BC",
    assay.type = "relabundance", na.rm = TRUE)
p <- plotReducedDim(tse, dimred = "PCoA_BC")
library(dplyr)
selected.subjects <- names(which(table(tse$subject)==2))
table(table(tse$subject)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(Timepoints=Var1, Subjects=Freq)
p + geom_path(
    aes(x=X1, y=X2, group=subject),
    arrow=arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches")),
    data = subset(
        data.frame(reducedDim(tse), colData(tse)),
        subject %in% selected.subjects) %>% arrange(time)) +
    labs(title = "All trajectories with two time points") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
tse <- getStepwiseDivergence(tse, group = "subject", time_field = "time")
top.selected.subjects <- subset(
    data.frame(reducedDim(tse), colData(tse)),
    subject %in% selected.subjects) %>%
    top_frac(0.1, time_divergence) %>% select(subject) %>% .[[1]]
p + geom_path(
    aes(x=X1, y=X2, color=time_divergence, group=subject),
    data = subset(
        data.frame(reducedDim(tse), colData(tse)),
        subject %in% top.selected.subjects) %>%
    arrange(desc(time)),
    arrow=arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"), ends = "first")) +
    labs(title = "Top 10%  divergent trajectories from time point one to two") +
    scale_color_gradient2(low="white", high="red")+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
selected.subject <- data.frame(reducedDim(tse), colData(tse)) %>%
    group_by(subject) %>%
    summarise(total_divergence = sum(time_divergence, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(total_divergence==max(total_divergence)) %>% select(subject) %>%
    .[[1]]
p +  geom_path(
    aes(x=X1, y=X2, group=subject),
    data = subset(
        data.frame(reducedDim(tse), colData(tse)),
        subject %in% selected.subject) %>% arrange(time),
    arrow=arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"))) +
    labs(title = "Longest trajectory by divergence") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

workflows.name: factor_and_dmn_plotting
workflows.intent: Visualize relationships between categorical factors and evaluate Dirichlet Multinomial Mixtures (DMN) fit.
input: dmn_se (TreeSummarizedExperiment object with pre-calculated DMN fit)
workflows.stages: 1. Plot categorical factor relationships using column tiles ;; 2. Plot DMN fit diagnostics (e.g., Laplace goodness of fit)
workflows.code:
data(GlobalPatterns, package="mia")
se <- GlobalPatterns
plotColTile(se,"SampleType","Primer") +
    theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0))
data(dmn_se, package = "mia")
names(metadata(dmn_se))
plotDMNFit(dmn_se, type = "laplace")
